[spoiler=[b]The People's Republic of Astanir[/b]]

[b]The People's Republic of Astanir[/b]

Victory was imminent. The Astaniran people could feel it. In these bombed out homes and on the streets that had split open through the sheer intensity of missile and rocket fire and across the polluted rivers and its rat-infested landfills with its starving children collecting recyclable junk to be sold for the barest scrap, the lowest, weak, and dying dregs of the human race were slowly but surely unifying behind the feeling that the end was near.

Horano Benir, Chairman of the Committee of Executives of the Democratic Council (CEDC) was quite well-aware of this, and in the morning of 17 June 2026, he would humbly ask all non-Astaniran members of the CEDC government to resign their posts. David Cyriacus and Yun Caibo, the seniormost of these "foreign" officials, would quickly accede and have all subordinate foreigners also resign, at last leaving CEDC with an all-Astaniran regime. After all, these Qianxun, Sanguinian, and Vespurian advisors had already taken up position in QASIC. 

Their continued meddling in the Astaniran Democratic government itself was no longer warranted or needed.

After a brief meeting with the rump CEDC, Benir receive consensus that time was now right to formally abolish the Democratic Council and all Arono-era institutions and to make provision for the creation of a new Astaniran state. At conference of senior officials in the capital city of Astan, Benir would proclaim the formation of the "Astaniran supreme power", a provisional technocratic government that was to map out the popular vision of the post-civil war Astanir, inviting the entire Democratic movement, the popular committees, and the non-affiliated citizenry to elect representatives in their respective localities to prepare a Constituent Assembly that was to draft a new constitution.

Until matters could be resolved, this new state is to be called the "People's Republic of Astanir", and was to operate along a "socially-conscious political line" to ensure the rapid upliftment of Astanir's beleagured, traumatized, and hapless populace after all these years of brutal civil war, internal strife, corruption, and national degradation.

To this end, the Benir government would ask the international community to recognize the People's Republic of Astanir "sole successor to the rights and obligations" previously beholden to the still technically extent Astaniran Republic. The Tribal Republic of Kuhaw-Astan, an ally of the Benirist government, would by comparison be declared to be a completely new entity, not representative of the Shamatine Astaniran nation but rather of its substantial Argossian minority, which had previously fought as an independent belligerent due to years of abuse by Astanir's dictatorial governments long past.

Even more specifically, Horano Benir would ask the nations of Erene to adopt a policy of non-recognition towards the Daesunian-dominated United Democratic Forces, a paramilitary group currently occupying the Astaniran Southern Islands. (https://i.imgur.com/4i7a2k0.png). On its exact reasoning for this appeal, the Benirsts would list a number of key points:

[list=1][*]In occupying the Southern Islands, UDF forces [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=rmb/postid=60453738]instigated ethnic cleansing operations[/url] to eradicate the islands' native Argossian minorities, which constituted genocide.

[*]The UDF, being an Amaralo-centric paramilitary force, is openly racist, supremacist, extremist, and imperialist. It has no goals of uplifting the Astaniran nation, rather expediting the prompt separation of the ethno-state they've crafted into the Daesunian sphere of influence.

[*]The government of Daesun, which is the UDF's foremost patron, had illegally declared these islands to be one large "humanitarian zone", which operates in direct contravention to Astaniran sovereignty.

[*]Daesun has encouraged UDF units to maintain substantial military forces within this "humanitarian zone" until such time that their seccession can be made into [i]fait accompli[/i] by the international community.

[*]The People's Republic of Astanir presently controls the national capital and the overwhelming majority of state institutions. Through this, it has provided social breakthroughs, in the conducting of local elections, the resolution to the Llyndorran flu that has tormented the city of Astan, the rebuilding of Astanir's war-torn cities, and the resumption of commercial enterprise during the nation's darkest hour.[/list]

Having resolved that all these stated points were truths, with objectively verifiable evidence of their occurences through Nordiheimian accounts of the rescue of Argossian tribes fleeing UDF persecution, Sanguinian records of Daesun's aggressive diplomatic conduct on QASIC's attempts to halt shipments to the UDF, and Daesun's own public proclamations of the so-called humanitarian safe zone, the Benir govenrment would appeal all the "anti-imperialist powers" of Erene to refuse recognition of the UDF and its military occupation of the Southern Islands.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]QASIC summer phase offensive[/b]]

[b]QASIC summer phase offensive[/b]

David Cyriacus would receive glowing reports of QASIC's advances made in the north and south. In exactly a single night, the entire frontline of the Isolationist armed forces have collapsed, equipment on the lines completely abandoned, entire storehouses filled with MREs, canned goods, and grain have been left unattended. Hundreds of thosuands of soldiers were fleeing en masse to their second, third, fourth lines of defense, completely and utterly swamping the Isolationists' already strained logistics and supply trains just as QASIC prepared yet another push the next day.

On the flipside, however, despite the overwhelming success of their initial offensive, Cyriacus noted that QASIC was behind schedule. In the very center of the formation, Freya Moran's 1st Maneuver Army had trouble making advances against the sheer density of Isolationist trenchworks, pillboxes, bunkers, and barbed wire. The same seems to have transpired in Operation Menghuan, where Restorationist forces had effectively dug-in against the 3rd and 6th Maneuver Armies despite anticipation of their weakness after all these months of inaction against the lethargic Isolationist armed forces.

And yet, so what? In just a single night, QASIC forces have stormed through about 200 kilometers of land. These roads and bridges that were to become the speartip of the Isolationist armed forces' counteroffensive were now greeting the tracks of Qianxun tanks, self-propelled guns, and trucks. Victory was certain now. The Isolationist frontlines have completely and utterly collapsed. There was no soldier on the enemy lines who possessed instructions to fight in pursuit of triumph. Their orders were to remain in their pillboxes and hope that at the hour of their defeat, they'd die knowing that they've made QASIC bled every single step of the way. 

However, even this, Cyriacus would deny.

To properly leverage their aerial superiority, Wuying-89 fighter jets would be ordered to refit their armaments. Conventional 500kg bombs and 122 mm rockets would be swapped out in favor of fresh units filled up with thermobaric filler. The cast-cured PBX, aluminum powder, and gelled fuels necessary for such weapons would be crafted from Astaniran chemical plants in Democratic territory, with materials supplied by Tencor's Oil Row. While less reliable than conventional high explosive on open ground, heavier, and problematic to store, thermobaric filler excelled in the trenches and other confined geometries where its afterburning and pressure waves would be the most effective at puncturing ear drums, rupturing lungs, and rendering entire trench systems uninhabitable.

Next, QASICOCEAN and 5th Man. Army were to now fully commit to a massive push in the southern coastline. Without any air support and naval reinforcements to possibly aid the Isolationists in the south, Bai He's 5th Man. Army would run into virtually no resistance in their advance through the Astaniran coastal territories, with naval missiles and drones clearing out entire kilometers of trench networks before they could even catch sight of QASIC ground forces. 

The hope now was to sweep past these bombed out defenses to sweep through the southern flank of the Isolationist forces, turn north and smash into them on two sides. Isolationist forces will either need to execute a complicated rearrangement of their forces to face Bai He's force and risk getting completely overrun by the 1st and 2nd Man. Armies, or else holdfast and become victims of what may very well be the largest encirclement in modern military history.

Last but not least, Freya Moran and Edwin Roylance would organize a unit of special operations forces called "Eureka Group" (after Moran's callsign) to infiltrate deep into the Isolationist armed forces' enemy lines. Totaling around 2,268 men from the SummitONE Corps of Commissionaires, these special forces would work in detachments of 12 men each, either dropping via helicopter into Isolationist territory or walking on foot through breaches in the Isolationist trench systems created by the QASIC offensive. Expected to work up to 300 kilometers beyond the frontlines, these spec ops units were tasked with digging up and destroying fiber optic lines, destroying unexploded ordnance to prevent tech capture, rescuing downed pilots, calling CAS against enemy fortifications and artillery systems, and simulating encircling raids to draw enemy forces away from the frontlines. 

In the mean time, 1st and 2nd Man. Armies would keep up the pressure. Certainly the Isolationist forces in the center of the lines were the densest, yet these same lines were now being overrun by their own fleeing forces, without supplies, logistical disruptions by SummitONE special forces, and now intense bunk-busting operations and thermobaric bombardments by QASICAIR forces, the overwhelming range and reconaissance advantage of QASIC artillery fire, relentless coastal and drone bombardments. In Freya Moran's own words, "It was like one massive turkey shoot, with targets that never seemed to run out."[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Argos Strait Confrontation[/b]]

[b]Argos Strait Confrontation[/b]

As the Daesunians would continue to send their ships over to UDF territory, they would be "escorted" throughout the entire journey by Sanguinian military boats and drones, which would keep track of the exact composition of the Daesunians' aid relative to the strengths of the UDF islands. Though, with Daesunian allies currently preoccupied with other matters, the overwhelming numbers advantage of QASIC forces, and the imminent collapse of all anti-Democratic factions in the Mainland, prospects for the UDF seemed rather grim.

Collectively, the UDF-held islands formed a total land territory of roughly 1,400 square kilometers spread out over four islands of varying topography. Historically, these islands relied heavily on the Mainland and on foreign investment for aid, best exemplified at the moment by its enduring reliance on Daesunian shipments to feed its solitary population. With the People's Republic of Astanir now proclaimed, however, the Sanguinians now began to prepare its drafting of a final military offensive to expel the UDF forces from the islands once and for all.

For now, drones would fly over UDF territory whenever possible to get a good look at its military installations, if the UDF even had any time to setup any that were substantial given the rapid pace of events. All the while, training exercises would be run by the QASICOCEAN forces, which by now had accumulated in the South of Astanir bearing down ominously over the entire Astaniran area of responsibility on all sides, ready and waiting for the final campaign of the civil war.[/spoiler]

[b]August 18, 2026: The Communist Question and The Peoples Republic of Astanir[/b]

Communism, a word that opposed and derided the very tenets of the idea of the Orthodox Empire. It was a word to be reviled and spat upon, a task which ideologically the government of Thýven was happily willing to commit. However, this was the 21st century, not the 20th, Thýven was in no position to be a reactionary state, anti-this and anti-that were out of the question for the government. 

Thus when the government of Thýven was presented with the fall of the Republic of Astanir, a weak and poorly organised government on an island off the south-easter coast of the continent of Shamat, and the sudden rise of the Peoples Republic of Astanir, the reaction of Thýven had to be weighed carefully.

There were two matters to be addressed, the Thawne doctrine held by the state of Daesun, a large nation located across the ocean to the East of Astanir on the continent of Xianzhou, which prohibited foreign expansion into the continent of Xianzhou, and the position of that nation towards the government of Astanir.

Ultimately the question boiled down to, Do we recognise a country whose primary political form is against our very ideological values, or do we permit a large continentalist state to continue influencing affairs in the east?  

Thýven chose the first of the issues, moving to recognise the newly declared People's Republic of Astanir by permitting a $20 million aid package to be sent by the Bank of Tharkønn for the reconstruction and restabilisation of Astanir,. Furthermore discussions on securing a trade deal with that state would begin among members of the National Financial Committee.
